```{r,message=F}
library(tidyverse)
bballdata <- read.csv('ProjectData.csv')
bballdata <- bballdata %>% drop_na() %>% select(-c(player_id,year,xba,xslg,babip,launch_angle_avg,offspeed_avg_spin,flyballs_percent))
```


```{r}
#Multicollinearity Plot
library(corrplot)
corrplot(cor(bballdata[,-c(1,4)]),tl.cex=0.7)
```


```{r}
set.seed(1)

index1 <- sample(1:nrow(bballdata), round(0.8*nrow(bballdata)))
train_data <- bballdata[index1, ]
test_data <- bballdata[-index1, ]
```


```{r}
library(glmnet)
X <- train_data %>% select(-c(last_name..first_name, p_era)) %>% as.matrix()
X_scaled <- scale(X)
y <- train_data$p_era

cv_ridge <- cv.glmnet(X_scaled, y, alpha = 0)
plot(cv_ridge)
```

```{r}
best_lambda <- cv_ridge$lambda.min
ridge_coeffs <- coef(cv_ridge, s = "lambda.min")
coeff_df <- data.frame(Feature = rownames(ridge_coeffs),Coefficient = as.vector(ridge_coeffs)) %>% arrange(desc(abs(Coefficient)))

print(coeff_df)
predictions <- predict(cv_ridge, s = best_lambda, newx = X_scaled)
residuals <- y - predictions
plot(predictions, residuals,main = "Residuals vs Fitted (Ridge)",xlab = "Predicted ERA (yhat)",ylab = "Residuals")
abline(h = 0, lty = 2, col = "red")
```

```{r}
X_test_matrix <- test_data %>% select(-c(last_name..first_name, p_era)) %>% as.matrix()
train_mean <- attr(X_scaled, "scaled:center")
train_sd <- attr(X_scaled, "scaled:scale")
X_test_scaled <- scale(X_test_matrix, center = train_mean, scale = train_sd)
```

```{r}
predictions <- predict(cv_ridge, newx = X_test_scaled, s = "lambda.min")
y_test <- test_data$p_era
residuals <- y_test - predictions
mse <- mean(residuals^2)
print(paste("MSE:", mse))
rmse <- sqrt(mse)
print(paste("RMSE:", rmse))
```

```{r}
clean_labels <- c( #allows for variable names in plot to not be raw variable name
  "barrel_batted_rate"= "Barrel Rate (%)",
  "k_percent"= "Strikeout Rate (%)",
  "bb_percent"= "Walk Rate (%)",
  "hard_hit_percent"= "Hard Hit Rate (%)",
  "linedrives_percent" = "Line Drive Rate (%)",
  "offdiff" = "Fastball-Offspeed Velocity Gap",
  "whiff_percent"= "Whiff Rate (%)",
  "groundballs_percent"= "Groundball Rate (%)",
  "exit_velocity_avg"= "Avg Exit Velocity (mph)"
)

plot_data <- coeff_df %>% filter(Feature != "(Intercept)") %>% head(5) %>%
  mutate(CleanFeature = ifelse(Feature %in% names(clean_labels), clean_labels[Feature],Feature)) 

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = reorder(CleanFeature, abs(Coefficient)),y=Coefficient, fill=Coefficient >0)) +
  geom_col() + coord_flip() + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "blue", "TRUE" = "red"), 
                    labels = c("Reduces ERA (Better)", "Increases ERA (Worse)"),name="Impact on Pitcher Performance") +
  labs(title="Key Drivers of ERA According to Ridge Model",subtitle ="Top 5 Predictors identified from Ridge Regression",
    x ="Variable",y ="Coefficient") +theme_minimal() +theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```


```{r}
library(gbm)
gbm_model <- gbm(formula = p_era ~ .-last_name..first_name,interaction.depth=1,shrinkage=0.001,data = train_data,
  distribution = "gaussian",n.trees = 10000,cv.folds = 10)
best_iter <- gbm.perf(gbm_model,method ="cv")
```


```{r}
gbm_imp <- summary(gbm_model, n.trees = best_iter)
gbm_imp$var <- as.character(gbm_imp$var)
gbm_imp$var[gbm_imp$var == "barrel_batted_rate"] <- "Barrel Rate (%)"
gbm_imp$var[gbm_imp$var == "k_percent"] <- "Strikeout Rate (%)"
gbm_imp$var[gbm_imp$var == "bb_percent"]<- "Walk Rate (%)"
gbm_imp$var[gbm_imp$var == "hard_hit_percent"]<- "Hard Hit Rate (%)"
gbm_imp$var[gbm_imp$var == "offdiff"]<- "Velocity Gap (FB-OS)"
gbm_imp$var[gbm_imp$var == "linedrives_percent"] <- "Line Drive Rate (%)"
gbm_imp$var[gbm_imp$var == "offspeed_avg_break"] <- "Offspeed Average Break (inches)"
gbm_imp$var[gbm_imp$var == "out_zone_percent"] <- "Out of Zone Rate (%)"
gbm_imp$var[gbm_imp$var == "offspeed_avg_speed"] <- "Offspeed Average Velocity (mph)"
gbm_imp$var[gbm_imp$var == "whiff_percent"] <- "Whiff Rate (%)"
gbm_imp$var[gbm_imp$var == "fastball_avg_break_z_induced"] <- "Fastball Average Induced Break"
gbm_imp$var[gbm_imp$var == "fastball_avg_spin"] <- "Fastball Average Spin (rpm)"
top_10_imp <- gbm_imp[1:10, ]
top_10_imp <- top_10_imp[rev(rownames(top_10_imp)), ] 
par(mar = c(5, 10,2,1)) 
barplot(top_10_imp$rel.inf,names.arg = top_10_imp$var,las=2,col = "blue",main = "Top 10 Relative Influence from GBM Model",
        horiz = TRUE,cex.names = 0.6,xlab = "Relative Influence (%)")

gbm_preds <- predict(gbm_model, newdata = test_data, n.trees = best_iter)

gbm_mse <- mean((test_data$p_era - gbm_preds)^2)
print(paste("MSE:", gbm_mse))
```





```{r}
results1 <- test_data %>% select(last_name..first_name,p_era) %>% mutate(gbm_pred=gbm_preds,ridge_pred=predictions)
```

```{r}
library(randomForest)
rf_model <- randomForest(p_era ~ . - last_name..first_name, data = train_data,importance = TRUE)

rf_preds <- predict(rf_model, newdata = test_data)
rf_mse <- mean((test_data$p_era - rf_preds)^2)
print(paste("MSE:", rf_mse))
```




```{r}
#Plot to Make ERA vs Barrel rate with LOESS smoother
ggplot(bballdata, aes(x = barrel_batted_rate,y =p_era))+ geom_point(alpha = 0.5, color="steelblue") +
  geom_smooth(method="loess",formula=y ~ x, color = "darkred", fill ="lightgray") +
  labs(title = "ERA vs Barrel Rate",x ="Barrel Rate (%)",y ="Earned Run Average (ERA)") +theme_minimal() 
```

```{r}
train_gbm_preds <- predict(gbm_model, newdata = train_data, n.trees = best_iter)

train_gbm_mse <- mean((train_data$p_era - train_gbm_preds)^2)
print(paste("MSE:", train_gbm_mse))
```
